hooks.command: if [ -n "$FRIRING_SIGNAL_FILE" ]; then printf 'idle\n' >> "$FRIRING_SIGNAL_FILE" || true; else friring-cli session signal --state idle || true; fi
if [ -n "$FRIRING_SIGNAL_FILE" ]; then printf 'working\n' >> "$FRIRING_SIGNAL_FILE" || true; else friring-cli session signal --state working || true; fi

case "$(cat)" in *permission*|*Permission*|*approval*|*approve*) if [ -n "$FRIRING_SIGNAL_FILE" ]; then printf 'blocked\n' >> "$FRIRING_SIGNAL_FILE" || true; else friring-cli session signal --state blocked || true; fi ;; esac; true
if [ -n "$FRIRING_SIGNAL_FILE" ]; then printf 'done\n' >> "$FRIRING_SIGNAL_FILE" || true; else friring-cli session signal --state done || true; fi
